# CRE AI Studio

> AI training for commercial real estate pros: weekly hands-on tutorials and templates, live Q&A, and a community of hundreds of CRE pros.

CRE AI Studio teaches commercial real estate professionals to use AI tools in their daily CRE workflows through hands-on training, live workshops and a member community. It was founded by Jonathan Buckelew, Nadine Ezzie and Topher Stephenson and is operated by BES.AI, LLC. It also offers custom team training, consulting, speaking, a free newsletter and a library of AI use cases from real CRE professionals.

## Pages

- [Home](https://creaistudio.com/): AI training for commercial real estate pros. Weekly hands-on tutorials and templates, live Q&A, and a community of hundreds of CRE pros.
- [Newsletter](https://creaistudio.com/Newsletter): Free weekly AI tutorials, prompt libraries, and real CRE workflows delivered to your inbox.
- [Speaking](https://creaistudio.com/speaking): Book Topher Stephenson, AI keynote speaker and trainer for commercial real estate, for keynotes, workshops and webinars at CRE conferences and associations.
- [Training](https://creaistudio.com/training): Custom AI training for CRE brokerages, asset managers, and associations, with demos built on your own workflows. Recording and prompt pack included.
- [Workshops](https://creaistudio.com/Workshops): Live, hands-on AI workshops built specifically for CRE professionals. Learn to build, automate, and deploy AI tools for your commercial real estate business.
- [Consulting](https://creaistudio.com/Consulting): Custom AI consulting for CRE firms: Claude skills and agents, document intelligence, workflow automation, and AI strategy roadmapping.
- [Articles](https://creaistudio.com/Articles): AI articles and videos for commercial real estate professionals: NotebookLM, Gemini vs. Copilot, and the top AI tools every CRE pro should know.
- [Resources](https://creaistudio.com/Resources): CRE AI Prompt Library: ready-to-use AI prompts, guides, and templates built for commercial real estate professionals.
- [Meet Your Teachers](https://creaistudio.com/MeetYourTeachers): The three co-founders who teach CRE AI Studio: Jonathan Buckelew, Nadine Ezzie and Topher Stephenson.

## AI use cases

- [AI Use Cases for Commercial Real Estate](https://creaistudio.com/use-cases): AI use cases for commercial real estate: real CRE workflows in Claude, ChatGPT and Grok Bot, credited to their creators, with copyable prompts and checks.
- [How to Rebuild a Real Estate Proforma in Claude for Excel](https://creaistudio.com/use-cases/claude-for-excel-real-estate-proforma): Rebuild a sponsor proforma in Claude for Excel from screenshots and a rent roll in about 10 minutes. Workflow, copyable prompt, and what to check.
- [Rent Roll Cleanup With AI: Copyable Prompt and Template](https://creaistudio.com/use-cases/ai-rent-roll-cleanup-prompt): Clean a messy rent roll with one AI prompt: map columns to a standard template, keep originals, separate vacants, and get an exception log.
- [AI Lease Abstraction With Claude, ChatGPT and Your Template](https://creaistudio.com/use-cases/ai-lease-abstraction-claude-chatgpt-template): AI lease abstraction: a retail acquisitions VP fills a vendor-built Excel template with Claude and ChatGPT. Workflow, prompt, and checks.
- [AI for Property Management: Running Grok Bots Like Staff](https://creaistudio.com/use-cases/ai-for-property-management-grok-bot-staff): AI for property management: one broker runs 18 Grok Bots (2 more building) like staff. Hiring framework, job-description prompt, and checks.
- [Real Estate Underwriting Model Review: Claude and ChatGPT](https://creaistudio.com/use-cases/real-estate-underwriting-model-review-claude-chatgpt): Real estate underwriting review: Claude builds an audit tab, ChatGPT peer-reviews like an institutional associate, then back to Claude. Prompts and checks.
- [Real Estate Due Diligence Package Built With Grok Bot](https://creaistudio.com/use-cases/real-estate-due-diligence-package-grok-bot): Real estate due diligence with AI: a seller had Grok Bot build buyer folders from Google Drive, fill gaps, then audit the package as a buyer. Steps and checks.
- [Multifamily Underwriting With Claude Cowork in 5 Minutes](https://creaistudio.com/use-cases/multifamily-underwriting-claude-cowork): Multifamily underwriting with Claude Cowork: one investor taught it his model from the OM, rent roll and T12, saved a Skill, and now fills it in 5 minutes.
- [AI Spreadsheet Analysis: 5 Errors to Check in a Rent Roll](https://creaistudio.com/use-cases/ai-spreadsheet-analysis-error-check-real-estate): AI spreadsheet analysis fails in five ways: extraction, categorization, formulas, units and reconciliation. A real estate investor's rule for checking it.
- [Claude for Real Estate: AI Chief of Staff and Skill Library](https://creaistudio.com/use-cases/ai-chief-of-staff-cre-brokerage-claude): Claude for real estate at a CRE brokerage: one broker's Claude skill library for pitches, OMs and valuations, next to an AI chief of staff over admin agents.
- [Off Market Commercial Real Estate Sourcing With AI](https://creaistudio.com/use-cases/off-market-commercial-real-estate-ai-deal-sourcing): Off market commercial real estate sourcing with AI: build a buy-box database, find the owners behind LLCs, skip-trace in three passes, rank by condition.

## Use cases by tool

- [Claude](https://creaistudio.com/use-cases/tool/claude): Use cases for Anthropic's Claude in commercial real estate, including Claude for Excel, from real professionals' public posts.
- [ChatGPT](https://creaistudio.com/use-cases/tool/chatgpt): How CRE professionals use ChatGPT for underwriting reviews, lease abstracts, and more, credited to the people who shared them.
- [Grok Bot](https://creaistudio.com/use-cases/tool/grok-bot): How property managers, brokers and investors run Grok Bots for real estate work, credited to the people who shared them.
- [Excel](https://creaistudio.com/use-cases/tool/excel): AI workflows that live in Excel: proformas, rent rolls, lease abstract templates and model audits.
- [Manus](https://creaistudio.com/use-cases/tool/manus): How commercial real estate investors use the Manus AI agent to build deal sourcing tools, credited to the people who shared them.

## Use cases by task

- [Underwriting](https://creaistudio.com/use-cases/task/underwriting): AI workflows for real estate underwriting: rebuilding proformas, cleaning rent rolls, and auditing models.
- [Leasing](https://creaistudio.com/use-cases/task/leasing): AI workflows for leases: lease abstraction, lease review, and lease administration.
- [Property Management](https://creaistudio.com/use-cases/task/property-management): AI for property management: bots and workflows for operations, leasing, marketing and finance.
- [Rent Rolls](https://creaistudio.com/use-cases/task/rent-rolls): AI workflows for rent rolls: cleanup, normalization and tie-outs.
- [Due Diligence](https://creaistudio.com/use-cases/task/due-diligence): AI workflows for due diligence packages and document review.
- [Brokerage](https://creaistudio.com/use-cases/task/brokerage): AI for commercial real estate brokers: skill libraries, lead handling, prospecting and back-office agents.
- [Deal Sourcing](https://creaistudio.com/use-cases/task/deal-sourcing): AI workflows for finding commercial real estate deals: buy-box databases, owner research and outreach.
